measurement_limits: Concurrent CPU builds and ordinary desktop GPU activity contributed to variation; no gain is attributed to noise.
An initial attempt failed because system Python 3.9 lacks zip(strict=True), and overlapped a GPU correctness test; it is excluded. Recorded sets used Python 3.14 and no overlapping mining tests.

Warmup is excluded from attempts_per_sec. The benchmark waits for command completion and reads the normal solution buffer. The 21-zero threshold is a runtime argument; hashing has no early exit for this value.
Startup is measured separately as wall time minus completed one-batch benchmark time, without warmup.
